name: Password Policy Checker
description: Check whether a password meets length, character class and weak-password requirements.

hints.password: The password is judged by local rules only; it never leaves the browser and is never stored.
hints.output: The score reflects each check and the strength level combines it with the length.

faq.q: Does this replace a password manager?
faq.a: No. It only applies rules and does not check whether a password has been breached.

faq.q: How complete is the weak password list?
faq.a: Only the most common ones are included; a full check needs a breach database, which is out of scope here.
